persona: Mid-level SAP BW consultant with BW/4HANA project and support work
resumeText:
Rohan Kulkarni | Pune | rohan.kulkarni@example.com

SUMMARY
SAP BW consultant with 7 years on BW on HANA and BW/4HANA for manufacturing and retail clients.

EXPERIENCE
SAP BW Consultant, Sahyadri Analytics Services, Pune (2021 - present)
- Built ADSOs and composite providers for sales and inventory reporting in BW/4HANA.
- Set up ODP extraction from S/4HANA and wrote transformations and DTPs for 30 data flows.
- Wrote ABAP end routines and start routines to derive plant and region attributes.
- Monitor daily process chains and fix failed loads within the support SLA.
- Designed BEx queries and Analysis for Office workbooks for the finance team.
- Gathered reporting requirements from business users in workshops and wrote functional specs.

Associate Consultant, Deccan Infotech, Pune (2019 - 2021)
- Supported BW on HANA loads from ECC LO extractors for a retail client.
- Wrote SQL queries to reconcile BW data with source tables.
- Built SAP Analytics Cloud stories on top of BW live connections.

SKILLS
SAP BW/4HANA, BW on HANA, ABAP, BEx, Analysis for Office, SQL, SAP Analytics Cloud

EDUCATION
BE Computer Engineering, Savitribai Phule Pune University, 2019
